name: Ward L. Lambert Fieldhouse and Gymnasium
changes_since_round3: Replaced the poorly legible entrance patch with 116 staggered warm red-brown brick units and three restrained tone variations.
Added an unmarked adjacent asphalt strip beside the Stadium Avenue sidewalk and curb to communicate the street context without inventing lane markings.

Inspected the entrance geometry and found no tile/border/sidewalk overlap: the black surround was the existing solid entry walk shaded beneath the roof eave. Applied a modest ambient lift only to entrance/site concrete; building materials are unchanged.
Reopened the saved source and rerendered exterior and interior cutaway previews.
Retained the track mesh and remeasured its saved lane-one centerline perimeter at 199.9889567 m.

references.provider: Purdue University Engineering Computer Network, Ground Control Requirements
references.use: Identifies Stadium Avenue, its sidewalk, and a brick inlay at Lambert Fieldhouse's main entrance. The asphalt strip merely signals the adjacent named avenue; road width and lane arrangement are not sourced and remain schematic.
Official facility identity and indoor-track context.

entrance_material_geometry_check.finding: No geometric overlap among pavers, border, and sidewalk. The dark surround was the solid entry-walk surface under the roof-eave shadow, not a void or asphalt patch.
entrance_material_geometry_check.pavers: LAMB | Stadium entry brick inlay round4; top surface z=0.145 m
entrance_material_geometry_check.correction: A shadow-lift material using a restrained emission strength of 0.40 was assigned only to the entry walk, entrance threshold, sidewalk, curb, and border.

direct_mesh_measurement.method: Average paired inner/outer boundary vertices at each sample station to recover the lane-one centerline polygon, then sum each closed polygon edge in local meters.

uncertainties: Sidewalk, curb, brick inlay and roadway dimensions/extent are schematic; source confirms their relationship but does not provide measurements.
Road width and lane markings are unverified and intentionally omitted.
Roof profile, facade cadence, and interior event/seating layout remain schematic.
